as_told.title: Thane Eugene Cesar shot RFK, tied to Robert Maheu

plain: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. holds that his father, shot in Los Angeles in 1968, was killed not by Sirhan Sirhan, the man blamed for it, but by a man named Thane Eugene Cesar who fired from behind, and whom Michels describes as a security guard at Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft division. Michels tells this in several episodes, saying he has talked to RFK Jr. about it at length; in one version Sirhan may have fired too, and he links it to the businessman Howard Hughes and his aide Bob Maheu. The point, if true, is a thread tying the killing to the secret aerospace world.
